name: tyloo-live
description: Tyloo Live - local-first football match recorder for Tyloo FC

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tyloo/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @tyloo/shared" "npm run dev -w @tyloo/api" "npm run dev -w @tyloo/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @tyloo/shared && npm run dev -w @tyloo/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tyloo/shared && npm run build -w @tyloo/api && npm run build -w @tyloo/web
